band.basis: Sum of the seven components above, excl. GST, Auckland 2026. Nominal 25 leaves: ~$15,840-$26,440 (mid ~$21,140). Supply items are vendor list prices excl GST; installation is the QV Carpenter rate; keying and site setup are labelled allowances (~9-14% of the total, so the band is not allowance-dominated). Main drivers (lockset kit, closer, labour) are all cited. Band is wide because QV's hardware rates are a poor fit for mid-range ANSI Grade 2 commercial hardware and its supply-only hinge rate is well above retail; confidence low. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design/consent, leaf/frame/hanging, access control, fire-rated hardware, access equipment and paint.

Sum of cited QV rows + fetched NZ trade prices + labelled allowances, per door leaf, excl. GST, Auckland 2026. Main drivers are all sourced: lock body (web, Lockwood 3772 $240 excl GST), lever furniture (QV t12:r2 $209, web $220), closer (web Dormakaba TS68 $159), hinges (web Yale $12.80-14.39 ea), door stop (QV $20.50-51) and labour (QV Carpenter $81.30/hr x 1.5-2.25 hr). Allowances (restricted cylinder, keying, setup, sundries) total $95-$235/leaf = 11%-18% of the band, under one third. Nominal 25 leaves: $22,100 - $32,900 excl. GST. BAND SITS ABOVE the draft $620-880: the draft's $195-290 lock line understates NZ trade prices - a Lockwood-class commercial mortice lock BODY is ~$240 and a commercial lever furniture set a further ~$209-220. A lower-tier Brava/Metro Grade 2 lock + lever set (~$90-160 furniture) could pull the lock line down ~$150-250/leaf, giving roughly $700-$1,050/leaf. QV's own hardware rows (premium Legge 991 mortice combos $739-$1,040; LCN closers $790-$1,010) sit above this band and would be used only for a premium architectural schedule.

band.unit: ea (per door leaf, complete hardware set fitted)
band.basis: Sum of the seven components above: low $873 (vendor mid-range supply + QV labour + keying) to high $2,137 (QV premium Legge/LCN rows + QV labour + keying). Mid ~$1,505/leaf. Nominal 25 leaves: ~$21,800 - $53,400 excl GST. GST, preliminaries, margin, design and consent excluded; leaf, frame, hanging and morticing excluded. Allowances (keying, setup) are minor; the main drivers (lockset, closer) are sourced. The band is wide and confidence low because QV's hardware library specifies premium brands heavier than the Grade 2 / EN size-3 spec, and because QV's lock/closer rows do not state whether fixing is included.
